title: Location permissions warning shown when permissions granted Android 9.0
symptom: Every time I access settings on xDrip+ where I am given the option to enable location setting for xDrip+. However on checking the permissions are already granted. This warning seems to be triggered incorrectly.
cause: The warning appears when location is not on, or when battery saver mode or an app that tries to extend battery life aggressively turns off location, or due to a version regression starting from 20190110-14fecb8.
fix: Under Location, with it enabled, click Mode and select High accuracy. Alternatively, enable 'Do not keep prompting for battery optimisation' to make the warning disappear.
settings_changed: Do not keep prompting for battery optimisation → enabled
evidence_quote: Under Location, with it enabled, click Mode and select High accuracy. I hope this helps.
